description: Single inline glass card rendered for the three fatal pre-fill outcomes (not-found / no-session / load-error), replacing the current blank error screen. One component driven by a `kind` prop so all three read consistently.

retrying.description: Retry in flight; shows spinner (loadError only)

notFound.title: We couldn't find this transaction
notFound.subcopy: It may have been deleted or moved.

noSession.title: You're signed out
noSession.subcopy: Sign in again to edit this transaction.

loadError.title: Couldn't load this transaction
loadError.subcopy: Check your connection and try again.

behavior: Renders in place of the form body when the transaction can't be populated. Header stays (BackButton visible); the Delete action is hidden in these states. loadError's Retry returns the screen to the skeleton loading state.

accessibility.colorIndependent: each kind pairs a distinct icon + a headline word; loadError red is backed by the word 'Couldn't load'
